$comment: Upload variants. Each is a prefab variant of the root avatar prefab (or of the variant it `extends`) with feature prefabs added as children; `features` lists the ones the generator makes sure are present. Slugs are the names the avatar is uploaded under. `about` is for whoever reads this file and is not sent anywhere. Features whose package is not installed are skipped with a warning. `worstRank` is the worst VRChat performance rank the variant may build to on PC and `worstRankMobile` on Android and iOS; the checks fail if it ranks lower. `model` is the fidelity level a variant is built from: left out, the full model on PC and the lite one on Android and iOS; "lite", the lite one everywhere. `platforms` (pc, android, ios; all three when left out) says what the variant is built for. `wardrobe` names another set of clothes the variant is built wearing: Blender exports each wardrobe as a model of its own on the same skeleton (BlenderExports/cass-<wardrobe>.fbx and its -lite), and the build exchanges the meshes by name. Features that cannot work on mobile say so themselves and are left out of those builds. `local` lists prefabs a variant adds that are not in the repository, each by the GUID its author shipped it with, with the name, author and address it is credited by; `atView` stands it at the avatar's view position. They are bought assets whose terms forbid passing them on. A variant with any is only made, built or uploaded in a project where all of them have been imported (every command skips it elsewhere and says why), its description credits them, and it uploads private and without the licence tag. A feature may be given as an object, {"path": ..., "pcOnly": true}: the variant then leaves it out of its Android and iOS builds (its parameters stay, so the list is the same on every platform), for something that works there but that the variant cannot afford under the mobile ranks. How much a variant carries goes by the rank it is held to and what it is for: cass-lite carries nothing it can do without, a variant at Good everything that fits at Good, and a variant that is Medium anyway everything that is of use to it. `deprecated` lists variants that are no longer made: the slug, the avatar id it was uploaded under, which variant has what it had, and why. Their prefabs are gone from the repository; scripts/cass.sh retire <slug> takes the avatar down from VRChat. `root` names the root prefab a variant stands on where that is not cass's own: another avatar built by this pipeline (the wirenook bot, net.wirenook.bot), whose variants are given features and are built, checked and uploaded like any other. `description` replaces the shared description for such a variant, whose credits are not cass's. `unreleased` makes a variant upload private although nothing it carries asks for that; take it away, rebuild and run `scripts/cass.sh publish <slug>` to make the avatar public.
description: Cassidy's avatar. AGPLv3. github.com/CassidyPrather/cass-avatar Body: SiroinoSotai by Siroino. Face: Mizunashi Hiyori by HENGE.

variants.about: The one for where performance is tight: the low-polygon model on PC as well, with locomotion and nothing else that costs. Being away still locks the body and glitches it, from the lite prefab, which adds no mesh, material or sound. Nothing is to be crammed into this one.

Everyday build, and what every other build starts from: default outfit, weighty locomotion baked for this avatar's own skeleton (scripts/cass.sh gaits), face tracking, the crash while away, and everything that fits beside those at Good: the party tricks (bonk hammer, vanishing act, mosaic censor, busy sign) and the outfit shuffle. The tricks and the shuffle are left out of the Android and iOS builds, which have no room for them at Medium; there this is cass-lite.

Adventure build, for going out and for leading a group: flight, a stepladder for a lifted play space, a carry seat, a catch-up portal, seats to put down in a ring or facing a screen, a laser pointer that pings, a megaphone, a flashlight and a lantern, screen notices and a beacon, on top of everything cass has. The placed things are meshes of their own, which is Medium; it does not try to stay at Good, and what used to be cass-event is this.

The adventure build with one real light source: the flashlight, a spotlight, which can be left standing in the world. It replaces both of cass-adv's glowing stand-ins. Any light on an avatar ranks it Poor and a second Very Poor, hence one light and a variant of its own.

The adventure build with one real light source: the lantern, a point light, which can be left standing in the world. It replaces both of cass-adv's glowing stand-ins. Any light on an avatar ranks it Poor and a second Very Poor, hence one light and a variant of its own.

The build for playing with contacts, with someone or alone: everything from net.wirenook.contacts (it reacts to VRChat's standard contact traits, and carries the tester that emits each one and launches things, the shield that burns and the targets to set down) and the shape collector, a collect-the-shapes course to lay out in any world. One avatar to clone for both halves of a test. PC only.

A sampler for choosing how the avatar walks: the root avatar with every walk style of the locomotion package baked for it, and a Walk style menu to switch between them in game. It does not extend cass, whose own locomotion would be a second claim on the same playable layers. Its controllers are large and are not committed; scripts/cass.sh gaits styles writes them. PC only: it is for trying on, and the choice is made once.

cass in the cyber wardrobe: a techwear jacket, a utility vest, a pleated skirt with a lit hem, chunky boots and a headset in place of the hat. The same avatar, skeleton and switches; only the clothes differ, and they are exchanged by mesh name at build time like the low-polygon model.

The everyday build carrying Quick Hack by DiNe Shop, a bought prop. The prop is not in the repository: its terms do not allow passing it on, or uploading it where others could clone it. So this variant can only be made where its package has been imported (see `local`), and it uploads private. PC only, as the prop is.

variants.description: A low-poly robot from wirenook.net, with a sprite face. AGPLv3. github.com/CassidyPrather/cass-avatar
variants.about: Another avatar altogether, on the same pipeline: a low-poly robot with pixel textures, a face made of sprites, and rabbit ears and a tail projected in light (net.wirenook.bot). It carries the features cass carries, unchanged, which is what it is for: the crash while away, with its window and sounds, and the party tricks on PC.

deprecated.why: The party tricks fit beside the everyday build at Good, so cass carries them.
It was cass-adv with more. cass-adv now has all of it and is Medium, as this was.
The shuffle is a switch in the Outfit menu now, so it needs no avatar of its own.
The shape collector is a contact game; it lives with the other contact toys.
